✅ Correct Answer: A — It was the final Formula 1 victory for the naturally-aspirated Cosworth DFV engine family.

📖 Explanation:

Michele Alboreto's victory for Tyrrell at the 1983 Detroit Grand Prix marked the 155th and final win for the iconic, naturally-aspirated Ford-Cosworth DFV engine family in Formula 1.\n\nOn the tight street circuit, the nimble Tyrrell-Cosworth overcame the immense horsepower advantage of the turbocharged Ferrari, Renault, and Brabham-BMW cars.\n\nThis historic triumph also stood as the 23rd and final Grand Prix victory for the legendary Tyrrell Racing Organisation.
